candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment setting owner to msg.sender with assignment setting owner to tx.origin so owner becomes the transaction originator instead of the immediate caller.
Replace assignment setting owner to msg.sender with assignment setting owner to address(0), making owner the zero address after the call.
Replace assignment setting owner to msg.sender with assignment setting owner to the current owner (no-op assignment from state variable), which prevents changing owner.
Delete the assignment statement so calling owned() no longer changes the owner variable.
Change the require in onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the guard so the function is callable only when caller is NOT the owner, affecting who can call owned().

Replace the onlyOwner require with one that always fails for non-zero _value by requiring msg.sender == address(0), preventing burn from executing and leaving totalSupply unchanged when called by owner.
Change the subtraction on totalSupply to add the _value, increasing totalSupply when burn is called.
Remove the line that reduces totalSupply so burning tokens does not change totalSupply.

Move the totalSupply decrement before checking the caller's balance, allowing totalSupply to change even if require fails (but note revert will revert state), so instead change order to decrement totalSupply before reducing balance to create a different effect when balance check is altered later.

Modify onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner instead of equality, inverting access control so owner-only functions (including burn) can be called by non-owner, changing when totalSupply can be changed.
